title: Scheduled minimums
help: Raise the minimum replicas during a time window, for example on weekdays from 08:00 to 20:00. Outside every window the base minimum applies again.
timezoneHelp: A name such as Europe/Berlin. Empty means UTC.
error: Check the schedule windows: use times like 08:00, a different start and end, a known time zone, and a minimum no higher than the maximum.
